name: cache-tax
description: Local fork of cache-tax (karanb192/cache-tax 2.2.1) that adds a Resend and pay button to a refused cold send and makes /keepwarm always a rolling 6h window from the last turn. Publishes each warm ping as state cache-tax.lastPing for cache-meter. Replaces cache-tax@claude-code-mods; do not enable both.
